claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Bicalutamide at 2.5 uM is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent, since it is a cytostatic AR antagonist whose only growth-inhibitory effects require AR-dependent prostate cancer lines and are not a general killing mechanism.
